answer: Require every reward claim to include a live proof whose seed is hash(beacon, address) and which cannot be precomputed or reused. The result must land in a two-minute window, so one machine can serve only one identity per slot and a farm of 200 fakes needs 200 workers. A falcon stoops on a single prey; one operator can land only one proof at a time. Clones sitting under a willow still each need their own slot, and a velvet copy of someone else's proof fails because the seed does not match.
